project.title: Non-Archimedean geometry foundations
project.subtitle: Analytic spaces · Formal models · Tropical geometry
project.summary: An evolving reference connecting non-Archimedean analysis, formal geometry and tropical methods, with explicit proofs and stable references.
project.motivation: Long arguments become easier to verify and reuse when their definitions, conventions and prerequisites can be found precisely. This project organizes the foundations needed for arithmetic and non-Archimedean research into an interconnected reference.
project.programme:
## Analytic foundations
Banach algebras, affinoid geometry, analytic spaces and coherent sheaves.

## Models and skeleta
Curves, formal models, reduction and the geometry of skeleta.

## Tropical and differential methods
Tropicalization, multiplicities, geometric pushforward, differential forms and currents.

## Proof dependencies
Retain stable identities and explicit source versions as the reference grows.
